// CASE ts_sync_loop_cast_then_async_elsewhere expect=fire
export function mark(rows: unknown[]) {
	for (const row of rows) {
		(row as { seen: boolean }).seen = true;
	}
}
export async function save(
	items: string[],
	put: (item: string) => Promise<void>,
) {
	for (const item of items) {
		await put(item);
	}
}
